# THAMUN (থামুন)

> Meet the scam before it meets you.

THAMUN is a bilingual (Bangla and English) scam-call rehearsal web app designed for parents, grandparents, and first-time mobile-money users.

## Core Pages
- `/`: Overview, how a practice round works, three safety questions, and FAQ.
- `/practice/takapay-support`: Interactive practice call using the fictional wallet TakaPay.
- `/pause`: Rapid 3-question check and local trusted-contact call screen for real-life calls.
- `/privacy`: Privacy commitments, zero-transcript-storage guarantee, and educational limits.

## Safety Commitments
- Uses only the fictional wallet TakaPay (no real brands or phone numbers).
- Client-side and server-side guards block PIN, OTP, phone, and card numbers.
- Transcripts are never logged or stored.
